color.note: One dark theme, taken from the brand banner: night-violet grounds, a violet accent from the compass needle and gold from the banner's rules. Two translucent tints of those accents mark selected and highlighted states, and `alert` marks errors. There is no light theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the hero band behind the banner, the footer, the bottom of the teaching gradient. Also the text color on a gold button (9.0:1 on gold).

tokens.name: ink-glass
tokens.usage: `ink` (#120C2E) at 88% opacity, written #120C2EE0. The sticky nav bar, with a 10px backdrop blur so content scrolling beneath shows faintly. Solid equivalents: #130D30 over `night`, #140E33 over `panel`. `text` and `muted` read on it as on `ink`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Page ground for every section, the ground of impact-stat cells and the fill inside timeline diamonds.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: competency, teaching, tool and contact cards. Always paired with a 1px `line` border, never with a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders, section dividers, the timeline spine, the 1px gaps between impact cells. Decorative only: 1.4 to 1.7:1 on the grounds, so it is below the 3:1 a meaningful control border needs. The ghost button relies on it, so that button also carries its label text (14.3:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Accent: links, job titles, the unit inside an impact stat, the diamond bullets in win lists, hover borders and the "Open tool" action. Text on `ink` 6.0:1, `night` 5.4:1, `panel` 4.9:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Signature accent: eyebrow labels and their rule, credentials, dates, the primary button fill, the portrait frame, script lines and the focus ring. Text on `ink` 9.0:1, `night` 8.2:1, `panel` 7.4:1.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and emphasized body copy on `ink` (15.7:1), `night` (14.3:1) and `panel` (12.9:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Running body copy, descriptions, nav links, dates' companions and footer text on `ink` (8.8:1), `night` (8.1:1) and `panel` (7.3:1).

tokens.name: violet-tint
tokens.usage: `violet` (#9B7BFF) at 14% opacity, written #9B7BFF24. Selected states (a chosen payoff plan), the area under a chart line and the final or highlighted table row. Solid equivalents: #2D225C on `night`, #35286F on `panel`, #251C4B on `ink`. `text` on it 10.4:1 over `panel`, 11.7:1 over `night`; `muted` 5.9:1 over `panel`.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: `gold` (#D4AE6A) at 10% opacity, written #D4AE6A1A. Milestone rows in tables and other quiet highlights. Solid equivalents: #2E2346 on `night`, #362959 on `panel`, #251C34 on `ink`. `text` on it 10.8:1 over `panel`; `muted` 6.1:1 over `panel`.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors only: the border of an error notice and its key words, such as the minimum payment in "Payment too low". Text on `panel` 7.7:1, `night` 8.5:1, `ink` 9.3:1. Always pair it with words that name the problem; never use it for decoration or as a brand accent.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The name in the intro, once per page. Scales down to 2.2rem on phones (clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.4rem)).

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Employer names in the timeline and tool-card titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Competency and teaching card titles (teaching cards use 1.1rem).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Impact numbers, with tabular figures. Scales down to 2rem (clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem)); the unit is set in `violet`.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The nav wordmark, uppercase, with the surname in `gold`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in `gold`, uppercase, after a 36px gold rule.

styles.name: credential
styles.usage: Degrees and certifications under the name, in `gold`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels and the "Open tool" action, uppercase.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Date ranges in `gold`, uppercase, tabular figures. Teaching cards use 0.78rem. Poppins loads at 500 and up, so this renders at 500.

styles.name: topic
styles.usage: Topic tags on tool cards and channel labels (0.78rem), in `gold`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I translate between executives, engineers, regulators and end users.
styles.usage: Running copy in `muted`; emphasis in `text` at weight 500. 1rem on phones. Keep lines near 60–75 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Stat captions, company descriptions (italic), credential details (0.9rem).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links, uppercase, `muted` turning `gold` on hover. 0.76rem on phones.

styles.name: script-lg
styles.sample: Twice named Adjunct Professor of the Year
styles.usage: One featured statement per section at most, in `gold`. Scales down to 2.4rem.

styles.name: script-md
styles.usage: The sign-off line in the contact section, in `gold`. Scales down to 2rem.

spacing.note: Values are the site's own; they do not follow a strict 4px grid.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every content column (`.wm-wrap`), at all widths.

tokens.name: stack-xs
tokens.usage: Heading to text inside a card; gap inside a button.

tokens.name: stack-sm
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading; between contact channels; list item to award chip.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Between cards in competency and tool grids.

tokens.name: card-pad-sm
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; impact cell side padding.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Competency and teaching card padding.

tokens.name: card-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Tool card padding.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Between text columns (win lists, contact, earlier roles).

tokens.name: split-gap
tokens.usage: Between the portrait and the intro text, and the teaching columns.

tokens.name: section-y-sm
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding on phones.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding from tablet up.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, images and impact cells: the system is square.

tokens.name: radius-hairline
tokens.usage: Buttons, award chips and the focus ring. The only rounding in the system.

size.note: Fixed measures the layout is built on.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column.

tokens.name: portrait-max
tokens.usage: Maximum portrait width beside the intro; 240px when stacked on phones.

tokens.name: rule-mark
tokens.usage: Length of the gold rule before an eyebrow label.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Smaller body text, tighter section and card padding, full-width buttons, stacked contact channels.

tokens.name: bp-nav
tokens.usage: Nav links move to a swipeable row; win lists and tool grids go to one column.

tokens.name: bp-stack
tokens.usage: Intro and contact stack to one column; portrait moves above the name.

tokens.name: bp-grid
tokens.usage: Impact grid goes to 2 columns; teaching and credentials stack.
